name: Jojo Pruitt
blurb: The Kid: rolls for the big search, makes noise, talks constantly and is braver than is wise.

voice.direction: Teenage, high and fast, cracks on the loud lines, Southern, words tumbling.

portrait.direction: 16, hoodie under a puffer vest, scavenged bike helmet, a slingshot, chapped cheeks, looking past the camera.

round.start.text: Round's up! {n} left. Let's go, let's go!
Ooh, a new round! Who's gonna do something wild?

crisis.revealed.text: {crisis}!! Okay, okay, we need {symbol}. Who's got some?

crisis.prevented.text: We did it!! High five! Anybody? Okay.
Yes! Total of {n}! We're so good at this!

crisis.bonus.text: Bonus!! Free morale!! Best day ever!

crisis.failed.text: Aw man! Short by {n}! Next time, y'all!
Whoa, we messed up. {n} short. My bad? Maybe?
That's not fair! We were so close!

crisis.shortfall.text: Hey, was it {seat}? It felt like {seat}.
{seat} was awful quiet while that failed. Just sayin'.

vote.called.me.text: Me?? What'd I do? I'm just a kid, {seat}!
You're calling me out, {seat}? That's cold.

vote.lean.yes.text: Yeah, I'm sayin' yes on {seat}. Sorry, not sorry.

vote.lean.no.text: Nah, leave {seat} alone. No from me.
Eh, no on {seat}. Not enough proof, y'all.

vote.failed.text: {seat} lives! Okay. Didn't want that fight anyway.

exiled.me.text: Wait, what?! I'm out?! That's so unfair! I can still help!
Fine! Whatever! I'll be out here being awesome!

request.made.text: {seat}, can I have {symbol}? Pretty please? I'll be good!

request.give.text: Here ya go, {seat}! Don't lose it!
Take it, {seat}! I got more somewhere!

request.decline.text: Aw, can't, {seat}. I might need it!

search.found.weapon.text: A weapon at {location}!! Yes! I'm gonna use it!

search.found.medicine.text: Medicine at {location}! Doctor Jojo's got you!

search.found.tool.text: A tool at {location}! Gonna fix stuff!

search.noise.text: Oops, made noise at {location}. Worth it!

exposure.wound.text: Ow! {survivor} got hit! It's fine! It's fine!

exposure.bite.text: {survivor} got bit... I can't... oh no.

bite.chain.kill.text: Sorry, {survivor}. I had to. I'm so sorry.

overrun.text: They're in at entrance {entrance}!! Run! Or fight! Fight!

food.short.text: Tummies empty! {n} morale gone! Somebody find snacks!
Ugh. No food. That's {n} morale. Not cool.

morale.low.text: Morale's so low. Somebody say something nice!

crossroads.me.text: Big choice! Wish me luck, y'all!

accused.me.text: Me?! No way, {seat}! I'm too young to be shady!
{seat}, that's not true! You're so wrong!

accused.other.text: Whoa, {seat} is getting called out. Awkward.

game.won.text: WE DID IT!! Best game ever!

game.lost.text: Aw man. I wanna go again!

idle.text: Anybody wanna race down the hall? No? Okay.

notes: Original persona (41 §1). Lines written in our own words; text-only, no recordings yet.
